name: 93953 · Pebble Beach, CA
findings: ZIP 93953 (Pebble Beach) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93953 (Pebble Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 93953 (Pebble Beach) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.
